text:
Tara R: Quick question for month close  reseller partner returned a $15,000 commission credit against an annual prepaid customer invoice (INV-2024-0999). Do we reduce deferred revenue or treat as contra-expense to commissions? Close Thu EOD.
Jared B: Can you paste vendor note and service period? Also did invoice include gross-up or pass-through fees?
Tara R: Service period 2024-08-01 to 2025-07-31. Original contract $150,000 annual prepaid; commission was booked to sales expense 6400 when invoice paid. Vendor note: "commission adjustment due to over-accrual on cooperative marketing spend."
Melissa C: If commission was originally recorded as an expense (not a reduction of contract consideration), the credit could be contra-expense. But if commission was effectively a price concession tied to the customer contract, GAAP indicates adjust contract consideration -> deferred revenue change. Need facts.
Aaron (FP&A): Quick check: original deferral GL 2400 = 150k; monthly amort 12,500. If we treat credit as contract reduction = new total 135k -> monthly 11,250. Timing matters for what portion has been recognized.
Jared B: How many months recognized so far?
Tara R: Recognized through 2024-10 (3 months).
Melissa C: Recognized portion of the $15k (if contract reduction) = 3/12 * 15k = 3,750 recognized; remaining 11,250 would reduce deferred balance. If contra-expense, it would reduce sales expense in current period by full 15k and not touch revenue.
Olivia Controller: This is a judgment call. We need partner communication that ties the credit to customer contract value vs commission reconciliation. Also consult audit. For month close: do NOT post revenue-reducing JE without Controller + CFO approval.
Tara R: Vendor email: "adjustment to commission due to over-accrual on cooperative marketing; credit applied to INV-2024-0999." Attaching PDF.
Aaron (FP&A): To avoid delaying close, suggest interim suspense treatment that keeps the accounting flexible:
```
DR 2400 Deferred Revenue      15,000
CR 9999 Suspense Clearing     15,000
```
That removes potential effect from the recognized revenue until we decide.
Melissa C: If we later decide contra-expense, we reverse suspense and post:
```
DR 9999 Suspense Clearing     15,000
CR 6400 Sales Commissions     15,000
```
If we decide contract reduction, final JEs will split recognized vs deferred portions.
Olivia Controller: Agreed. Park in suspense for close. Aaron, prepare a one-page analysis showing (1) vendor language, (2) impact on recognized revenue by month, (3) tax and commission recovery implications. CFO & Audit review required early next period.
Tara R: Will upload docs now. Also flagged billing to confirm customer won't receive a corrected invoice that could change treatment.
revbot: Reminder: month-end cutoff 2024-10-31 17:00 UTC. Any JEs after cutoff require CFO tag and justification.
Jared B: Thanks  For now I'll queue the suspense JE if Controller signs off on parking it.
Aaron (FP&A): Drafting the impact workbook now  will post by 08:30 tomorrow and route for approvals.
Olivia Controller: Good. Keep audit in the loop.
